These teams are tasked with ensuring that systems and services can be restored efficiently and effectively following an outage. They conduct regular drills and simulations to test recovery procedures and identify potential gaps. The incident response team may also collaborate with the IT operations team to ensure that all necessary protocols are in place. In some organizations, this responsibility may be shared between the business continuity management team and the technical operations team. The goal is to maintain service availability and minimize downtime through preparedness and continuous improvement.
